title: GEMglNewList
description: create or replace a display list

messages.description: compilation mode, which can be GL_COMPILE or GL_COMPILE_AND_EXECUTE

arguments.description: compilation mode, which can be GL_COMPILE or GL_COMPILE_AND_EXECUTE

body: [GEMglNewList] calls glNewList() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. GL constants are numbers here: [GLdefine] turns a name like GL_LINES into its value. See glNewList in the OpenGL reference.
